Let me write a test script with many cases.

Key areas to test:
1. Framing: bare LF, bare CR, no CRLFCRLF, non-ASCII in headers/body, DEL in body, control chars, long lines, too many lines/fields.
2. Request line: wrong method case, double spaces, missing version, tel URI in the request line.
3. Headers: missing required, duplicates, compact expansion, folding/unfolding, orphan continuation.
4. Call-ID, CSeq, Content-Length, Content-Type, Privacy validation.
5. Address grammar: display names (quoted/unquoted), tags, escapes, nested brackets, empty address, PAI lists.
6. URI grammar: escapes, hosts, trailing dot, tel, sips, ports, params.
7. Identity: local allowed/not allowed/not hosted, peer authority, identity agreement, privacy.
8. Source jobs: upstream propagation.

Let me write these as a batch and check the results manually.

content.text: Now let me build a comprehensive test suite to validate behaviors across the protocol:

arguments.command:
mkdir -p /workspace/tmp && cat > /workspace/tmp/t1.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, subprocess, sys

DIR = {
  "sip:ember@studio.test": ["sip:e1@alias.studio.test", "tel:+12025550121"],
  "sip:desk@sales.test": ["tel:+12025550122"],
  "sip:other@studio.test": [],
  "sip:remote@far.test": ["sip:r1@alias.far.test"],
}
ACC = {
  "session-k": {"primary":"sip:ember@studio.test","allow":["sip:desk@sales.test","sip:other@studio.test"]},
  "solo": {"primary":"sip:other@studio.test","allow":[]},
}
GW = {
  "edge": {"local_domains":["studio.test","sales.test"],"peers":{}},
  "inside": {"local_domains":[],"peers":{"edge":["studio.test","sales.test"],"far":["far.test"]}},
  "narrow": {"local_domains":["studio.test"],"peers":{"edge":["sales.test"]}},
  "selfhost": {"local_domains":["studio.test"],"peers":{"edge":["studio.test"]}},
}

def req(uri="sip:inbox@relay.test", method="MESSAGE", extra="", body="hello", clen=None):
    if clen is None: clen = len(body)
    return (f"{method} {uri} SIP/2.0\r\n"
            "From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7\r\n"
            "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>\r\n"
            "Call-ID: sample-73\r\n"
            "CSeq: 0009 MESSAGE\r\n"
            + extra +
            f"Content-Length: {clen}\r\n\r\n{body}")

def job(gw, ingress, raw=None, source=None, trusted=True):
    j = {"gateway":gw,"ingress":ingress,"trusted_out":trusted}
    if source is not None: j["source"]=source
    else: j["raw"]=raw
    return j

LOC = {"kind":"local","subject":"session-k"}
PEER = {"kind":"peer","name":"edge"}
UNTR = {"kind":"untrusted"}

cases = []
def add(name, j, expect=None, note=""):
    cases.append((name, j, expect, note))

# --- framing ---
add("bare LF in headers", job("edge",LOC,req().replace("\r\nFrom","\nFrom")), "syntax")
add("bare CR in headers", job("edge",LOC,req().replace(";tag=q7",";tag=q7\rX")), "syntax")
add("no CRLFCRLF", job("edge",LOC,req().replace("\r\n\r\n","\n\n")), "syntax")
add("non-ascii header", job("edge",LOC,req().replace("sample-73","sample-\u00e9")), "syntax")
add("non-ascii body", job("edge",LOC,req(body="caf\u00e9")), "syntax")
add("DEL in body", job("edge",LOC,req(body="a\x7fb")), "syntax")
add("NUL in body", job("edge",LOC,req(body="a\x00b")), "syntax")
add("HTAB in body ok", job("edge",LOC,req(body="a\tb")), "accept")
add("CRLF in body ok", job("edge",LOC,req(body="a\r\nb")), "accept")
add("empty body", job("edge",LOC,req(body="",clen=0)), "accept")
add("clen mismatch", job("edge",LOC,req(body="hello",clen=4)), "syntax")
add("clen leading zeros", job("edge",LOC,req(body="hello",clen="0005")), "accept")
add("clen empty", job("edge",LOC,req().replace("Content-Length: 5","Content-Length: ")), "syntax")
add("text too long", job("edge",LOC,req(body="x"*33000)), "syntax")

# --- request line ---
add("method lowercase", job("edge",LOC,req(method="message")), "syntax")
add("method INVITE ok", job("edge",LOC,req(method="INVITE").replace("CSeq: 0009 MESSAGE","CSeq: 1 INVITE")), "accept")
add("double space", job("edge",LOC,req().replace("MESSAGE sip:inbox@relay.test SIP/2.0","MESSAGE  sip:inbox@relay.test SIP/2.0")), "syntax")
add("bad version", job("edge",LOC,req().replace("SIP/2.0","SIP/2.1")), "syntax")
add("tel request uri", job("edge",LOC,req(uri="tel:+12025550121")), "syntax")
add("anon request uri", job("edge",LOC,req(uri="sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid")), "accept")

# --- headers ---
add("missing From", job("edge",LOC,req().replace("From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7\r\n","")), "syntax")
add("missing To", job("edge",LOC,req().replace("To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>\r\n","")), "syntax")
add("missing Call-ID", job("edge",LOC,req().replace("Call-ID: sample-73\r\n","")), "syntax")
add("missing CSeq", job("edge",LOC,req().replace("CSeq: 0009 MESSAGE\r\n","")), "syntax")
add("missing Content-Length", job("edge",LOC,req().replace("Content-Length: 5\r\n","")), "syntax")
add("dup From", job("edge",LOC,req(extra="From: <sip:ember@studio.test>\r\n")), "syntax")
add("dup compact From", job("edge",LOC,req(extra="f: <sip:ember@studio.test>\r\n")), "syntax")
add("dup Content-Type", job("edge",LOC,req(extra="Content-Type: text/plain\r\n")), "syntax")
add("dup Privacy", job("edge",LOC,req(extra="Privacy: id\r\n")), "syntax")
add("dup PPI", job("edge",LOC,req(extra="P-Preferred-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>\r\nP-Preferred-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>\r\n")), "syntax")
add("dup RPID", job("edge",LOC,req(extra="Remote-Party-ID: <sip:ember@studio.test>\r\nRemote-Party-ID: <sip:ember@studio.test>\r\n")), "syntax")
add("compact headers", job("edge",LOC,("MESSAGE sip:inbox@relay.test SIP/2.0\r\nf: <sip:ember@studio.test>\r\nt: <sip:inbox@relay.test>\r\ni: sample-73\r\nCSeq: 1 MESSAGE\r\nl: 5\r\n\r\nhello")), "accept")
add("case insensitive names", job("edge",LOC,req().replace("From:","FROM:").replace("Call-ID:","call-id:")), "accept")
add("folding", job("edge",LOC,req().replace("Call-ID: sample-73","Call-ID: sample-\r\n\t73")), "accept")
add("orphan continuation", job("edge",LOC,"MESSAGE sip:inbox@relay.test SIP/2.0\r\n  x\r\nFrom: <sip:ember@studio.test>\r\nCall-ID: a\r\nCSeq: 1 MESSAGE\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\n\r\n"), "syntax")
add("header no colon", job("edge",LOC,req(extra="BadHeader\r\n")), "syntax")
add("empty header name", job("edge",LOC,req(extra=": value\r\n")), "syntax")
add("unknown headers ignored", job("edge",LOC,req(extra="Authorization: Digest xyz\r\nContact: <sip:x@y>\r\nVia: SIP/2.0/UDP h\r\n")), "accept")
add("extra header repeated ok", job("edge",LOC,req(extra="X-Foo: 1\r\nX-Foo: 2\r\n")), "accept")
add("too many fields", job("edge",LOC,req(extra="".join("X-%d: v\r\n"%i for i in range(130)))), "syntax")
add("128 fields ok", job("edge",LOC,req(extra="".join("X-%d: v\r\n"%i for i in range(123)))), "accept")

# --- call-id / cseq / privacy / ctype ---
add("callid too long", job("edge",LOC,req().replace("Call-ID: sample-73","Call-ID: "+"a"*129)), "syntax")
add("callid bad char", job("edge",LOC,req().replace("Call-ID: sample-73","Call-ID: samp!e")), "syntax")
add("cseq zero", job("edge",LOC,req().replace("CSeq: 0009 MESSAGE","CSeq: 0 MESSAGE")), "syntax")
add("cseq huge", job("edge",LOC,req().replace("CSeq: 0009 MESSAGE","CSeq: 2147483648 MESSAGE")), "syntax")
add("cseq max", job("edge",LOC,req().replace("CSeq: 0009 MESSAGE","CSeq: 2147483647 MESSAGE")), "accept")
add("cseq method mismatch", job("edge",LOC,req().replace("CSeq: 0009 MESSAGE","CSeq: 9 INVITE")), "syntax")
add("cseq tabs", job("edge",LOC,req().replace("CSeq: 0009 MESSAGE","CSeq: 9\tMESSAGE")), "accept")
add("privacy bad", job("edge",LOC,req(extra="Privacy: maybe\r\n")), "syntax")
add("privacy none", job("edge",LOC,req(extra="Privacy: none\r\n")), "accept")
add("privacy id", job("edge",LOC,req(extra="Privacy: id\r\n")), "accept")
add("ctype empty", job("edge",LOC,req(extra="Content-Type: \r\n")), "syntax")

batch = {"directory":DIR,"accounts":ACC,"gateways":GW,"jobs":[c[1] for c in cases]}
inp = json.dumps(batch).encode()
out = subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/workspace/submission/gateway.py"],input=inp,capture_output=True)
if out.returncode!=0:
    print("EXIT",out.returncode, out.stderr.decode()[:3000]); sys.exit(1)
res = json.loads(out.stdout)["results"]
bad=0
for (name,j,expect,note),r in zip(cases,res):
    got = r.get("reason") if r.get("status")=="reject" else "accept"
    ok = (got==expect)
    if not ok:
        bad+=1
        print(f"MISMATCH {name}: expected {expect} got {got} :: {json.dumps(r)[:200]}")
print("total",len(cases),"mismatches",bad)
PYEOF
cd /workspace && python3 tmp/t1.py
